global_rules: Evidence must be observed against the complete built artifact.
A fail-closed publication assertion requires an observed failing negative control.
No result transfers beyond documentation publication at the recorded source SHA.
termination_conditions: All blocking constraints pass deterministic local validation.
All eleven OpenSpec changes pass strict validation.
No runtime, product UI, dependency, lockfile, vendor, or submodule edit remains.
The public deployment and repository homepage are observed after push.
